name: inspira-animated-list
blurb: Auto-cycling notification list with staggered enter/exit animations and delay control.
description: AnimatedList component that receives children array and cycles through items at configurable delay via useEffect timer loop. Each item animates in with scale/opacity spring, older items exit. Also exports Notification component for individual styled items.
use_when: You need an auto-playing notification feed showing activity timeline with animation.
avoid_when: For interactive notification centers; use a popover-based system instead.
a11y: Auto-cycling may be distracting; component respects prefers-reduced-motion via motion library.
